facts.material: polyimide flexible substrate, copper runs, gold edge fingers, plastic connectors
facts.form: flexible circuit with two attached non-printed connectors

gri_path: GRI 1: ch 85 note on printed circuits: does not cover circuits combined with non-printed elements
GRI 1: heading 8536 connections to electrical circuits

rejected_alternatives.reason: flexible printed circuit, but note excludes circuits combined with attached connectors

classification.rationale: Because two non-printed connectors are attached, the ch 85 definition of printed circuits excludes it from 8534; connection function points to 8536.69.40.40. N344049 (in force) concerns a single printed circuit connector only, so it supports the line but is not a same-facts precedent.
